title: Initial configuration is ready
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic Boolean-tape Turing machine, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $m$ be a natural number. The initial configuration of $A$ on $x$ is ready at yard length $m$: it is in $A$’s initial state, its input head is at position $1$, its output is empty, and every cell at or to the left of each work-tape head minus $m$ is blank.
